qualitative.gate_2_reason: Discretionary big-ticket purchase deferrable in recessions; highly cyclical automotive OEM look-through exposure.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 2 (Rejected – G2 Essential Need). Holding company whose primary look-through asset is Volkswagen AG (with an additional stake in Porsche AG). Mass-market passenger automotive manufacturing is a highly cyclical, discretionary big-ticket purchase easily deferred by consumers during economic downturns, facing severe structural global overcapacity.
qualitative.evidence: Porsche SE's net asset value is overwhelmingly concentrated in Volkswagen AG voting shares and Dr. Ing. h.c. F. Porsche AG. Passenger vehicle purchases are deferrable big-ticket consumer durables characterized by intense price competition, high capital intensity, and cyclical earnings volatility.
